$description: The resource/rich-choice row anatomy (#3164), the second member of the PopupMenu family. Action rows keep pattern.popup-menu unchanged: single-line, exactly the experience control band (28px Web / 44px App). A resource row has a primary identity plus optional source/status/technically-formatted detail, so it wraps and takes its content's height; the same control band is its minimum, and on App the touch floor still applies to the whole row. Its list may grow beyond a narrow trigger up to overlay.choiceMaxWidth but never beyond Base UI's available width, and it never clips content horizontally. This block exists so the wrap/height/width exception is contracted rather than an accident at a consumer call site.
